summary: The proof is correct and complete. The inherited same-ray circuit decomposition is used with the correct aliases; the support-function inequality and both affine moment cancellations have the correct signs and dimensions; the selected missed-edge charges respect each shared edge's total decomposed capacity; the fresh-dual lower bound is invoked only in its legal positive-charge normalization; the zero-charge extension is handled directly; and positive homogeneity gives the claimed exact additivity because all component vectors on each edge lie on one nonnegative ray. The constructed field is feasible for the charged weighted dual, including zero-capacity coordinates, and its strictly positive dual value yields exactly the asserted circuit transversal in the zero-load case.
